authority.user_words:
首先，你需要读取这个小工具对话中的内容，从中获取我的需求以及前代项目的完成进度。前代项目主要是我让他把这个学期的一本通按章节拆分了一下，我们先用第一章进行测试。但我依旧不满意，所以你只要获取我的需求和他做了什么就行，不要被他的上下文所污染。
资源位置：我下载的视频都在下载目录里。
任务执行：我说做“一本通”的第几节，你就去按照这个批次划分。
学习目标：我说做第几节，你就得告诉我做这一节要听哪些课。听完这些课，必须能够完全做完“一本通”的这一节。
输出流程：先听哪一节课；再做哪一些题。按一本通讲义顺序：知识点讲解及右侧例题；类型题训练并说明题号；最后明确习题 ABC 组。每次输出需要视觉信息时调用已经配置的千帆 OCR API。
authority.interpreted_goal: 以原始一本通PDF为准，由Codex辅助视觉核对并修复OCR，完整清点第一章全部知识点、例题、直接变式和A/B/C习题，持续迭代五个零基础DeepSeek代理直到完整成功或存在不可伪造的外部阻塞。
acceptance: 逐页视觉核对第一章四节原始PDF，给出习题数与全部学习题项总数
有内容的PDF页不得在学生包中变成OCR空页
知识点+右侧例题+类型例题+直接变式+A/B/C习题均进入学生工作流
五个零基础DeepSeek代理最终完成全部题项和未见近迁移；24小时冷复测单独保持not_run直至真实时间到达

verified_memories.content: `community/` JSONL is the original fact source; SQLite is a rebuildable cache. Use UTF-8 Python files rather than PowerShell inline Chinese for B站 searches. Search results require a second check of `bvid`, date, plays, title/tags, and detail metadata. [Task 1]

The configured search produced 426 candidates, 54 above threshold, and 14 selected videos. Collection obtained 14 videos and 6,908 comments; nine had deep pagination, five hit `anti_bot:comments`. Subtitle retrieval was blocked for all 14 with `need_login_subtitle: true`. [Task 1]

Do not fabricate a transcript or infer its contents from a title. De-duplicate `access_gap` by video and reason, and label anonymous/hot or paged comments as samples rather than a strict random 30% or full corpus. A probe returning three comments is not a fixed API limit. [Task 1]

BetterGI intake should prefer repeated, low-risk, verifiable flows: collection routes, compass cleanup, daily resin/task scheduling, fixed character cycles, state prompts, and failure detection. Do not implement high-cheat-risk shooting automation. Treat comments, beta-server numbers, and Abyss mechanism advice as leads requiring official or visual validation. [Task 1]

Symptom: anonymous subtitle/comment endpoints appear to return enough data. Cause: subtitles require login and some videos trigger anti-bot. Fix: report per-video sample/total/access-gap evidence and retain blocked status rather than claiming full analysis. [Task 1]

Symptom: worker output or a temporary file is mistaken for clean delivery. Fix: verify all expected report files and raw JSONL remain intact; check and clean temporary worker artifacts before handoff when authorization permits. [Task 1]
FocusConsole, TaskBrowser, MobileApp, mobile.css, Apple HIG, Liquid Glass, 640, 44px, aria-pressed, viewport smoke
deviceSyncService, deviceSyncV2Service, remoteWritebackCoordinator, providerScope, credential-rotation, task-snapshot, TOCTOU, lease, backoff, 503

when requesting a “只读” FocusLink audit, the user said “不要编辑文件，不要启动写入型构建” and prohibited unrestricted Git/LFS -> collect current evidence only, make no cleanup/install/package/push, and mark unrun checks clearly. [Task 2][Task 3]

for delegated release work, the user required “5个deepseek智能体” -> dispatch exactly five locked `deepseek_worker` agents with disjoint ownership; preserve blocked/not-run states instead of backfilling with old artifacts. [Task 1]

Mobile: 640 navigation cascade was fixed; retain Liquid Glass for navigation/control layers and opaque business content. The screenshot harness writes PNGs and is not a standard release gate. Still inspect 640 reading order, actual 44px controls, recursive task indentation, completed-selection cleanup, `aria-pressed`/selection labeling, focus/announcement, final CSS cascade, and stale Android test selectors. [Task 2]

Release failure shield: local tests, old Huawei records, notification structure, simulated drag, or a successful package are not physical acceptance. Recover Huawei through authorized USB debugging/on-device authorization or current-network wireless debugging, then rerun same-version readback and physical UI checks. [Task 1]
installer-smoke.mjs, YIGOU_DESKTOP_USER_DATA, safeToRunFullLifecycle, rc.16, Yigou_API35, YIGOU_ANDROID_SIGNING, productionSmoke, BUG-072, BUG-074
when reporting “安装太慢”“bug一堆未解决”, split install time, running-upgrade close, legacy uninstaller, uninstall, and evidence-chain investigation; use five DeepSeek workers where requested. [Task 1]
do not overwrite the current install, touch real databases, or fabricate acceptance; keep a protection guard and honest `not-verified` status. [Task 1]

`desktop/installer-smoke.mjs` now provides phase timing (120/120/60-second warnings and 300-second hang cap), isolated `YIGOU_DESKTOP_USER_DATA`, and readiness guards for existing shortcut/uninstall registry/running process. `--dry-run` is a read-only preflight, not NSIS lifecycle proof. Run pnpm gates serially because parallel calls caused UNKNOWN-process conflicts. [Task 1]

Do not use isolated `node --test` or packaged smoke as a claim that fresh install/upgrade/uninstall completed. Run a full lifecycle only in a clean Windows user/VM or with explicit authorization after readiness permits it. [Task 1]
TomaToDo, 番茄ToDo, tomatodo-study-flow, cloudSyncUploadRecord, afinal.db, Record2, stable-marker, s1, pragma integrity_check, phone-readback

when the user says “手机端没有看到同步成功”, separately report desktop write, cloud acknowledgement, and independent phone readback; never call `success:true` phone delivery. When they say “只有六科名字就行”, keep names at subject level and do not create detailed tasks. [Task 1]
when the user says “快”“快点吧”, execute with concise factual progress rather than lengthy explanation. [Task 1]

The reusable entrypoint is `C:\Users\poyi\.agents\skills\tomatodo-study-flow\scripts\sync_subject_records.py`; it defaults to six subject names, stable-marker upsert, dry-run, and separate desktop/phone stages. Related skill: `C:\Users\poyi\.agents\skills\tomatodo-study-flow\SKILL.md`. [Task 1]

A cloud record is one fixed object: single uploads overwrite predecessors and array uploads produce “记录数据格式错误：不是 JSON 对象”. Do not use either as offline phone sync; do not mutate the phone DB without backup and independent readback. Put Chinese Python source in a UTF-8 file or Unicode-escape it to avoid PowerShell corruption. [Task 1]
Realtek 8852BE, Clash Verge, Mihomo, interface-name: WLAN, tun.auto-detect-interface, IgnoreNew, get empty name, local endpoint, 超级无敌疾风斩

the user corrected “原因根本不在这”“不是节点”“别给我乱改” and required `节点选择` remain manual `🇯🇵Japan 04` -> investigate Wi-Fi/link/driver/network-stack evidence before proxy hypotheses and never switch proxy selection without consent. [Task 1]

Strong final evidence favored weak home Wi-Fi: `超级无敌疾风斩` measured 12%–40%, while hotspot `save` measured 100%/-49 dBm with 30/30 gateway and 20/20 internet lossless probes. Check both motherboard antennas, placement/extension, obstruction/distance, router, and 2.4GHz coverage. [Task 1]

Observed Clash repair: fixed merge config to `interface-name: WLAN` and `tun.auto-detect-interface: false`; scheduled `Clash Verge (Admin)` with 30-second delay and `MultipleInstances=IgnoreNew`; current runtime had one Mihomo core and manual node restored. Avoid Mihomo `/restart`, which caused duplicate-core/port/TUN conflicts. [Task 1]

IPv6/TUN/proxy were plausible contributors but not proven root cause. Treat them as hypotheses, verify each change separately with small UAC commands, and do not claim a full cure until a real reboot and user confirmation succeed. [Task 1]
一本通学习系统_v6.1, target_identity, ENTRY_PASS, FULL_PASS, MAIN, COURSE_LOCAL, package_id, base_state_id, contamination, open_loops

the user said “必须用 luna”“保持三子智能体常驻”“用 luna max 强度” and wanted continued optimization -> honor an explicit model/effort/agent contract, but report actual model availability separately from requested parameters. [Task 1]

Keep four parts rather than one giant prompt: main prompt, state/return protocol, course-page prompt, and semantic regression suite. State independently tracks `progress_status`, `mastery_status`, `coverage_status`, `contamination`, and `unlock_status`; coverage alone does not release questions or prove mastery. [Task 1]
